correction.previous_assumption: A distinct continuous ledger root would retain the prior observer profile fingerprint.
correction.observed_result: The bounded smoke root correctly produced a distinct observer profile and run fingerprint because ledger paths are part of observer identity.
correction.accurate_position: Archive the invalid predecessor root intact and start the new run at the original bound path. This preserves the exact observer profile identity while creating a new run ID and empty ledger.

source_identity.interpretation: The twelve exact config, observer, collector, telemetry, lockfile, and dependency hashes in revision 2 remain unchanged and are required before start.

predecessor_disposition.archive_policy: Move the complete 180 MB observer directory on the same filesystem after all old report-only writers stop; do not delete or rewrite it.

continuous_acceptance: The new run emits a configuration identity with the exact frozen profile and run fingerprints.
The first audit has eight exact symbols, ten unique provider-symbol evaluations, no missing or duplicate routes, and no technical gaps.
Every observer row remains disarmed with execution authority none and zero routed actions, orders, and fills.
New lifecycle preregistrations freeze the new run ID and initial ledger prefix before their watchers start.
The invalid predecessor aggregate and smoke run are excluded from new cadence and profitability summaries.
failure_triggers: Any revision-2 source hash differs before start.
The predecessor backup target exists or the source root is still being written.
The new profile or run fingerprint differs from the frozen identity.
Any observer row has live authority or any routed action, order, or fill.
Any heartbeat gap exceeds a configured route entry-delay bound.
Any evidence is pooled across predecessor, smoke, and continuous run identities.
